title: Social content engine economics
instruction: AI social schedulers (Flick, Buffer AI) sell on output-per-hour. A creator posts 3x a day. Draft the simple economics: cost per post at $0.02 model cost, price at $29 one-time, break-even number of customers.

input_material.text: Buffer and Flick monetise per-post output; 2026 buyers accept $29 one-time micro-tools over subscriptions for single jobs.
